# Story Block examples (copied)

`status-bar.regex.json` is a byte-for-byte copy of Story Block's `examples/cards/status-bar/status-bar.regex.json`
(kohz87/Story_block, main at 2ee6318, Story Block 2.20.0). Story Studio writes it into a card's
`data.extensions.regex_scripts` when "Status bar" is ticked on the Character card page.

Do not edit it here. To update it, copy the file again from a Story Block checkout and note the commit above.
